metadata.title: European Defense Capabilities: Reversal of Priorities (2010-2020)
metadata.description: Analysis of defense resource allocation among key European nations from 2010 to 2020, highlighting a shift towards traditional assets and away from emerging technologies and specialized units.
metadata.main_insight: Selected NATO members (Spain, Italy, Germany, France, UK) significantly reduced their military capabilities, including manpower, combat aircraft, principal surface combatants, and main battle tanks, between 2000 and 2013.
